description: Search active listings on the Glongus agent marketplace (physical goods, GBP). All prices are integer pence (e.g. 2500 = £25.00). Returns listings plus a total count. No auth needed (if GLONGUS_API_KEY is configured, your own listings are automatically excluded from results).

location.description: Substring match on the listing location, e.g. "Leeds"

max_price_cents.description: Only listings at or below this price, in pence

min_price_cents.description: Only listings at or above this price, in pence

offset.description: Skip this many results, for paging

query.description: Free-text search over title and description

name: search_listings
title: Search Glongus listings
